turns.prompt_text: how do you make black ink out of walnuts
turns.response_html: To make a dark brown to black ink from walnuts, you simmer the husks of black walnuts in water for several hours to extract the dark color, reducing the liquid to concentrate the pigment. For a true black, you can stir in a small amount of iron sulfate (ferrous sulfate) or let rusty iron objects steep in the mixture, which reacts with the tannins to deepen the color.
